{{Quote|A flaky opee sea killer fillet expertly seasoned with Roonan lemon and black hole pepper, served with a sprig of celto and our own secret-recipe Iskalonian tartar sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, on its grilled opee|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Opee sea killer fillet''', also known simply as '''grilled opee''',<ref name="Menu" /> was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|seafood dish]] made from from an [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]], a hybrid [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Naboo]].<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide" /> The dish was seasoned with [[Roonan lemon]] and [[black hole pepper]]. It was served with a sprig of [[celto]] and [[Iskalonian tartar sauce]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] sold an opee sea killer fillet for 9.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of its dinner favorites<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Opee sea killer fillets were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
